title: Stop VNI West — Sign the Petition
lede: 85-metre steel transmission towers cutting straight through Hillside, Plumpton, Sydenham and Taylors Hill — wiping value off every home in their shadow and erasing the suburban amenity families bought into. Sign the petition demanding the project be halted, now.
photoCaption: PHOTO HERE — VNI West corridor through outer Melbourne suburbs

argument.h2: This isn't a transmission line. It's an imposition on the West.
argument.lede: The Victoria–NSW Interconnect West (VNI West) is being pushed through with the kind of speed Governments reserve for things they don't want scrutinised. The route runs straight through outer Melbourne's family suburbs — Hillside, Plumpton, Sydenham, Taylors Hill — at heights and proximities that will gut property values and erase the amenity people moved out west for. The consultation has been a tick-box exercise on a foregone conclusion.
argument.body: I am calling on the Government to stop this project immediately, table the underlying modelling, and put the underground alternative on the same level of disclosure as the overhead route — before more outer-west homeowners watch their biggest asset lose value to a tower they were never properly consulted on.
argument.quote: The people whose homes, streets and savings are on the line should not be the last people consulted. We will not accept a process that treats outer Melbourne as an empty corridor.
argument.planHeading: What I'm asking the Parliament to do
plan: Immediately halt all VNI West works, surveys and acquisition notices pending an independent route review.
Disclose, in full, every route-selection cost-benefit and property-value impact model relied on to date.
Cost the underground alternative on the same basis as the overhead route, and publish the comparison.
A binding statutory community consultation right for every suburb on the route before any further land access.
Mandatory compensation for every homeowner whose property value is impacted — paid up-front, indexed for the life of the asset.
Independent assessment of the cumulative impact on outer Melbourne suburbs — house prices, amenity, sunlight, views — across the entire corridor.
